snippet.title: Astrolander - New Gameplay Trailer & Steam Announcement!
snippet.description:
Astrolander is a revolutionary action-packed reimagining of platformers, built from the ground up to take full advantage of the DualSense™. Embark on a thrilling adventure featuring innovative 2.5D fused with 3D environments and gameplay, unique mechanics, and breathtaking worlds. Take control of a curious robot on a roll named Feedback and an adventurous rocket powered sidekick named Haptic on a quest to save the Most Valuable Programs (MVPs)!

🚀 WISHLIST NOW!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353450/Astrolander/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009270

📢 FOLLOW US ON SOCIALS!
Website: https://lostcartridgecreations.com/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/lostcartridge.bsky.social
X (Twitter): https://x.com/Lost_Cartridge
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jYRsnYDg7r
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@lost_cartridge/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lost_cartridge/

🤖 ASTROLANDER STORY
In a distant world, the MVPs were cheerful but outdated cartridge powered CRT robots. Cyberlution began spreading across the universe, turning happy creatures into robotic menaces, bent on conquering every planet. MVPs quickly became deactivated and recycled for parts to support the Cyberlution. The last free MVPs built two experimental CD powered robots, Haptic and Feedback, to rescue their friends and save the universe!

🕹️ BUILT TO TAKE FULL ADVANTAGE OF DUALSENSE™ ON PS5®
The Astrolander universe comes to life through extensive DualSense™ integration including haptic feedback, DualSense™ audio effects, and advanced use of adaptive triggers and gyro. Feel the breeze as you fly Haptic and sense surfaces come alive when you roll Feedback. Move your controller to aim your Wazer during battles with grouchy Cybersnaps, shake the DualSense™ to feed and distract lurking Cybergoi, and so much more. Prepare yourself for one of the best DualSense™ experiences!

🐲 WIDE RANGE OF GAMEPLAY MECHANICS & ENEMIES
Experience exhilarating action while you face off against enemies and epic bosses transformed by Cyberlution. Dodge rolling and bouncing furry mischievous Kedama creatures as you journey up swaying suspension bridges. Launch your CDjector to attack the stompy stumpy Kodama before they swing at you. Dart away from flying beachballs and send sparks flying on crawling Cybersnaps as you hose them down with your Wazer. Dodge deadly lasers as you hurl squeaky Cyberquax into the air with your Wavo. Take control of bumpy bumper boats and challenge the playful but naughty Cyberdrax to chaotic races through winding rivers while collecting powerups and tokens. Climb up treehouses and platform on flying thumping taiko drums.

💿 COLLECT CDS TO ACTIVATE UNIQUE ABILITIES
Activate 10 awesome abilities along your journey including CDjector, Wazer, Vizray, Wavo, and many more.

2️⃣ INNOVATIVE LOCAL CO-OP ACTION
Play solo or grab a friend for the optional fast-paced co-op mode. Two-players work together to control one character at a time. Test your skills and your friendships!

📽️ CG MOVIE LEVEL VISUALS & SOUNDTRACK
Stunning visuals brought to life with dynamic physics, a catchy original soundtrack, and immersive 3D audio.

#platformer #indiegame #playstation
